headline: Last session: Sensex surged over 800 points and Nifty reclaimed 22,500, led by strong gains in IT stocks.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 12 October.

why: Strong buying interest in IT stocks, led by TCS, drove market recovery in the last trading session.
FMCG stocks witnessed buying support, with the index rising over 2% on Friday.
Investors engaged in short covering after heavy market selloffs earlier in the week.
FII selling pressures persist with foreign investors pulling out over Rs 44,000 crore in October.
whatHappening: On the last trading day, Sensex jumped 800 to 1,000 points while Nifty closed above 22,500.
IT sector led market gains with a 3% surge during Friday's session.
FPI outflows crossed Rs 3 trillion for 2026 after intense selling over recent sessions.
Primary market remains active with companies like Jio and Zetwerk set to launch IPOs in October.
summary: Indian equities rallied sharply during the last trading session, with Sensex gaining around 900 points to close above 22,500 on Nifty. The recovery was driven by a robust performance in IT and FMCG sectors, offsetting persistent high foreign fund outflows. Markets remain closed today for the weekend and will resume trading on Monday, 12 October.
